name: Differentiable DOF Rendering
definition: A rendering pipeline that generates blurred images by convolving projected 2D Gaussians with depth-dependent blur kernels derived from a finite-aperture camera model, enabling differentiable optimization of camera parameters and scene geometry.
summary: Differentiable DOF Rendering extends 3D Gaussian Splatting by modeling defocus blur as a differentiable operation, enabling joint optimization of scene geometry and camera parameters.
